entities.name: UE request type
entities.description: Information element included by the UE when requesting release of NAS signalling connection or rejecting paging request from the network.

entities.name: NAS signalling connection release
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to release the NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: Paging request rejection
entities.description: Procedure where UE rejects a paging request from the network.

entities.name: MUSIM UE condition
entities.description: Condition where the UE is a MUSIM (Multiple USIM) device.

relations.description: NAS signalling connection release procedure includes the UE request type IE.
Paging request rejection procedure includes the UE request type IE.
Inclusion of UE request type IE is conditional upon the UE being a MUSIM device.
